settings.title: GUIDS in the Inbox
settings.description: The chosen GUIDS answers pending conversations (with no attendant) on its own and hands them to the team when needed.
settings.agentHint: Only a GUIDS that is on can be chosen. In the conversation, the customer sees the agent's name.

hints.grouping_seconds: Consecutive messages from the customer get a single answer. From 0 to 30.
hints.max_messages: Longer answers are joined into the last message. From 1 to 5.
hints.max_chars: Guidance for the agent to keep texts short. From 100 to 1,000.
hints.interval_ms: Pause between the messages of one answer. Up to 5,000.

settings.backToBot: After a handoff, the conversation goes back to the GUIDS with "Return to GUIDS" in the conversation panel. A resolved conversation in which the customer writes again reopens as pending, with the GUIDS.
settings.viewOnly: Only Inbox managers can change these settings.

errors.guidsNotActive: Choose a GUIDS of this workspace that is on.
errors.noGuids: No GUIDS answers the Inbox of this workspace.
errors.alreadyWithGuids: The conversation is already with the GUIDS.
